translations.web: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”
translations.bsb: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you in your time of trouble.”
translations.kjv: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
translations.asv: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them save you in the time of your distress.
